name: web-minimal-floating-nav-pills-collapsed-and-expanded-on-hatched-white
title: Minimal Nav Pills Collapsed and Expanded
whatItIs: A pale hatched-white field with two floating white pill navigations with soft shadows: a compact one of home, folder and add-note icons, and an expanded one where the folder item is highlighted in a pale blue pill with a monospace 'folders' label.
whatItMeans: Showing the collapsed and expanded state in one image explains the interaction, and a mono label gives a technical feel.
techniques: Collapsed and expanded states shown together
Active item expanding with a text label
Monospace label for a technical voice
Soft shadow on a very light background

vocabulary.definition: A selected item that widens to show its label.
A small bar hovering over content.
